name: Taifafeki

code.note: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 user-assigned code (range XAA to XZZ), so it can never name a real country. On the GDHCN DEV network XXR is an onboarded test participant (WorldHealthOrganization/tng-participants-dev XXR/) whose DSC signs the journeys' birth-dose DVCs (kid 916ffa567c0f44a2); its keys are test keys, not any ministry's.

description: A fictional country: the one the traveller visits. Its health workers give care abroad, sign what they give with the country's GDHCN key, and read the traveller's home record when they come back.

places.Kesaro: a border province; Kesaro Provincial Hospital is where the baby is born (J1) and a Kesaro clinic reads the family's records a year later (J4.1)

usedBy.smart-trust-demo: Country A: where the newborn is born (J1) and later seen at the point of care (J4.1).
usedBy.pilgrimage: the host country of the pilgrimage, which checks the pilgrim's health card on arrival.
